sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lyonesse is a lost land in the stories of Britain. The poets of the Matter of Britain said that an island of this name sank under the sea. Poets place it off Cornwall, near the Isles of Scilly. A rocky bank called the Seven Stones is said to mark its site. The tale joins a sunken city with a floating island of the Otherworld. Alfred Lord Tennyson wrote of its sunset bound.

okr.objective: Set down the tale of the lost land of Lyonesse.
